title: Visited Tape Cells Under Seam Composition
statement: Let $M_1$ and $M_2$ be machines with the same work tapes, and let $e$ be a state of $M_1$ and $a$ a state of $M_2$. Suppose a computation of $M_1$ from $c_0$ reaches $c_1$ after $T_1$ steps, with state $e$, and does not visit state $e$ at any earlier time $t<T_1$. For each work tape $i$, the set of head positions visited by the seam-composed machine from the state-renamed configuration $c_0$ through time $T_1+1+T_2$ is contained in the union of the positions visited by $M_1$ from $c_0$ through time $T_1$ and those visited by $M_2$ from the state-renamed configuration with state $a$ and the other data of $c_1$ through time $T_2$.
